title: Optimization
summary: Optimization seeks feasible points minimizing or maximizing an objective function.

context.note: Framework is named textually in this seed release; full recursive first-principles closure remains future work.

assumptions.text: A feasible set X and objective f:X→R or ordered codomain are specified.

content.plain: Optimization asks which allowed state scores best according to an explicit objective.
content.exact: A minimization problem is inf_{x∈X} f(x); a global minimizer x* satisfies f(x*)≤f(x) for all x∈X.
content.example: Minimize (x-3)^2 over R; the unique global minimizer is x=3.
content.caveat: An optimization objective encodes what is valued. Mathematical optimality does not imply the objective itself is appropriate.

relations.note: Local and global minima are different notions.
Search may trade local refinement against information gathering.
